Dec 12 artillery brought down part of the wall and the Japanese took the gate through the gap, swarming in at 17:00 (en.wikipedia Battle of Nanking; the timeline's ev-1212-zhonghua-shelling peaks at 17:00); the 47th regiment held a stretch of wall west of the gate at 12:20 (ja.wikipedia 南京戦); place and size 推测

Dec 12 a large portion of the wall gave way under the 16th Division's guns (en.wikipedia Battle of Nanking); the 9th Division faced the wall south-east of the gate (ja.wikipedia 南京戦); place and size 推测
